mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (0.16%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in the sustained accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an explicit monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The co-occurrence of a federal funds rate at or below 0.25% and an unemployment rate above 7.5% signals a policy response to a weak labor market, which typically precedes a recovery in equity valuations, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to high unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS <= 0.25 AND UNRATE >= 7.5 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), the labor market weakness triggers monetary policy accommodation and reduces the risk of recession, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 850 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods where HOUST < 850 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous decline in housing starts (below 850 thousand units) and industrial production (below 100 index) signals a broad-based economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods where HOUST < 850 AND INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (2017=100 base), it indicates a contraction in the manufacturing and industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment falls below 410 billion dollars (410,000 million), it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods where RSAFS < 410000 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
